recognize_zh: 上排（前期 T-LGLL）骨髓細胞量正常，CD8 與 TIA1 陽性的小 T 細胞呈線狀排列在竇狀血管內，CD3/TRBC1 雙染以紫色（TRBC1 陰性）為主；下排（轉化後）骨髓被大型不規則核、明顯核仁的淋巴細胞取代，CD8 膜染、TIA1 粗顆粒陽性，雙染仍幾乎全為紫色，顯示同一 TRBC1 限制性克隆。
features: Initial biopsy: normocellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes (A)
Small CD8+ and TIA1+ T cells in linear intrasinusoidal arrays (B, C)
CD3 (purple)/TRBC1 (green) dual stain: intrasinusoidal T cells purple-only (TRBC1-negative) against a mixed background (D)
Follow-up biopsy: hypercellular marrow effaced by large atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant cytoplasm (E)
Large cells show membranous CD8 and coarse granular cytoplasmic TIA1 (F, G)
Dual stain in the large-cell infiltrate is predominantly purple-only, consistent with the same TRBC1-restricted clone (H)
describe_en: The initial bone marrow biopsy is normocellular with an interstitial and intrasinusoidal infiltrate of small bland T cells that are CD8- and TIA1-positive, and CD3/TRBC1 dual staining shows a TRBC1-negative restricted population, consistent with T-large granular lymphocytic leukemia. The follow-up biopsy is hypercellular and extensively replaced by large atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant cytoplasm. These cells retain CD8 and granular TIA1 cytotoxic phenotype and remain CD3-positive/TRBC1-negative, matching the prior clone. With CD30 expression and identical TCR and mutational profiles reported, findings are consistent with large-cell transformation of T-LGLL to peripheral T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive CD8+ T cells are polytypic with both TRBC1-positive and -negative cells, lack intrasinusoidal clustering and do not show large-cell transformation.
HSTL also has intrasinusoidal marrow involvement but is usually γδ (TRBC1-negative because TCRβ is absent), CD8-negative, TIA1+/granzyme B-negative, and composed of medium-sized monotonous cells.
ALCL has hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30 and frequent loss of T-cell markers, lacking a documented preceding T-LGLL clone.
Aggressive NK-cell leukemia is surface CD3-negative, EBV-positive and lacks TCR rearrangement, whereas these cells are CD3-positive αβ T cells.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD8, TIA1; CD3/TRBC1 dual stain
